recipes.title: Warm Ground Cinnamon, Diced Apple & Walnut Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Classic cozy rolled oats simmered with finely diced sweet apple, fragrant ground cinnamon, milk, and chopped walnuts.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, finely diced apple, and ground cinnamon in a small saucepan 6 to 7 minutes until soft and creamy.
Spoon into a warm bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts and a light drizzle of maple syrup.
tips: Ceylon ('true') cinnamon is extra gentle and sweet if you enjoy cinnamon daily.
Warm aromatic spices make oatmeal taste sweet with very little syrup.

recipes.title: Creamy Ricotta, Sweet Pear & Cinnamon Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Warm toasted whole-grain bread spread thick with creamy ricotta, thin ripe pear slices, generous ground cinnamon, and honey.
steps: Spread warm toasted whole-grain bread with cool part-skim ricotta.
Arrange thinly sliced ripe pear across both pieces of toast.
Dust generously with ground cinnamon and finish with a light drizzle of honey.
tips: High in morning protein and ready in 6 minutes.
Ripe sliced banana or berries work just as well.

recipes.title: Whole-Grain Cinnamon & Vanilla Skillet French Toast
recipes.summary: Soft, golden whole-grain French toast soaked in milk, egg, vanilla, and fragrant ground cinnamon, cooked lightly in olive oil.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, and ground cinnamon thoroughly in a shallow bowl.
Dip bread slices briefly on both sides and cook in lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm topped with fresh blueberries and a spoonful of Greek yogurt.
tips: French toast is naturally soft, warm, and easy to cut cleanly with a fork.
Using mild olive or sunflower oil instead of butter keeps it light.

recipes.title: Cinnamon, Vanilla & Chia Seed Overnight Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Silky make-ahead chia breakfast whisked with milk, plain Greek yogurt, warm ground cinnamon, vanilla, and sweet raspberries.
steps: Whisk milk, Greek yogurt, chia seeds, ground cinnamon, and vanilla thoroughly until smooth.
Rest 5 minutes, whisk once more to eliminate clumps, divide into two jars, and refrigerate overnight.
Top with fresh raspberries right before eating.
tips: Ready to spoon straight from the fridge on busy or slow mornings.
Rich in gentle soluble fiber and protein.

recipes.title: Warm Mashed Cinnamon Sweet Potato, Yogurt & Almond Bowl
recipes.summary: Cozy grain-free morning bowl mashing warm steamed sweet potato with fragrant ground cinnamon, plain yogurt, banana, and sliced almonds.
steps: Prick sweet potato with a fork and microwave 5 to 6 minutes (or use baked leftover) until completely soft.
Scoop warm flesh into a bowl and mash smoothly with ground cinnamon and maple syrup.
Top with a cool dollop of Greek yogurt, sliced banana, and sliced almonds.
tips: Velvety, naturally gluten-free, and wonderfully easy to swallow.
Warm sweet potato and fragrant cinnamon taste like cozy pie filling for breakfast.

recipes.title: Moroccan Ground Cinnamon, Tomato & Red Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: Beloved North African harira-inspired red lentil soup warmed with ground cinnamon, cumin, crushed tomatoes, onion, and bright lemon.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then bloom ground cinnamon and cumin 30 seconds until warm and fragrant.
Add rinsed red lentils, crushed tomatoes, and vegetable broth; simmer gently 15 minutes until thick and velvety.
Finish with a bright squeeze of fresh lemon juice and ladle warm.
tips: Ground cinnamon adds subtle sweet warmth to savory tomato-lentil soup—a signature Moroccan technique.
High in gentle fiber and completely plant-based.

recipes.title: Silky Roasted Squash, Pear & Ground Cinnamon Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth, soothing autumn soup simmering cubed butternut squash, ripe pear, sweet onion, vegetable broth, and fragrant ground cinnamon.
steps: Soften onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in ground cinnamon 30 seconds.
Add cubed squash, diced pear, and vegetable broth; simmer 15 minutes until completely soft.
Blend silky smooth with an immersion blender and serve warm.
tips: Ripe pear and cinnamon bring natural gentle sweetness with zero cream or sugar needed.
Effortless to swallow and reheats nicely.

recipes.title: Warm Cinnamon-Roasted Carrots, Chickpeas & Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelized sweet carrots and chickpeas tossed with ground cinnamon, olive oil, and cumin, served over fluffy quinoa, spinach, and yogurt.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss sliced carrots and chickpeas with olive oil and ground cinnamon on a parchment-lined pan.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until carrots are sweet and fork-tender.
Divide baby spinach and warm quinoa into two bowls, pile spiced carrots and chickpeas over top, and add a cool spoonful of Greek yogurt.
tips: Carrots roasted with ground cinnamon turn irresistibly caramel-sweet.
Omit yogurt for a fully plant-based plate.

recipes.title: Spiced Cinnamon-Apple & Poached Chicken Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Mayo-free harvest chicken salad folding tender poached chicken, diced sweet apple, dried cherries, walnuts, and plain yogurt accented with cinnamon.
steps: Whisk plain Greek yogurt, fresh lemon juice, ground cinnamon, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Fold in tender diced poached chicken, finely diced apple, chopped dried cherries, and walnuts.
Serve on soft whole-grain bread or tender butter lettuce cups.
tips: A light whisper of ground cinnamon bridges savory chicken and sweet orchard fruit effortlessly.
High-protein and ready in 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Warm Cinnamon Farro, Sweet Potato & Spinach Lunch Bowl
recipes.summary: Hearty cooked farro and soft sweet potato cubes warmed with olive oil, apple cider vinegar, ground cinnamon, baby spinach, and pumpkin seeds.
steps: Warm olive oil gently over low heat and stir in ground cinnamon 20 seconds until fragrant.
Fold in cooked farro, sweet potato cubes, and apple cider vinegar and heat 3 minutes.
Toss in baby spinach off the heat until wilted, divide into bowls, and scatter pumpkin seeds over top.
tips: Cooked barley or brown rice swaps cleanly for farro.
Cozy, nut-free, and fiber-rich.

recipes.title: Greek Cinnamon-Tomato Braised Chicken (Kotopoulo Kokkinisto)
recipes.summary: Beloved Greek Sunday classic made weeknight-fast: tender chicken thighs gently simmered in sweet crushed tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and ground cinnamon.
steps: Brown chicken thighs and diced onion in olive oil 5 minutes, then stir in minced garlic and ground cinnamon 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and 1/3 cup water; cover and simmer gently 15 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and turns fork-tender.
Spoon the fragrant cinnamon-tomato chicken and rich sauce over warm cooked orzo.
tips: Greek cooks have paired cinnamon with tomato braises for generations because it rounds out tomato acidity naturally.
Soft orzo and tender braised chicken make a cozy, gentle dinner.

recipes.title: Warm Moroccan Cinnamon, Chickpea & Squash Stew
recipes.summary: Aromatic plant-based one-pot stew simmering cubed butternut squash, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, ginger, and fragrant ground cinnamon over couscous.
steps: Warm olive oil in a pot and bloom grated ginger and ground cinnamon 30 seconds until intensely aromatic.
Add cubed squash, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 18 minutes until squash is spoon-soft.
Ladle generously over fluffy warm couscous and finish with fresh parsley or lemon.
tips: Completely plant-based, mildly spiced, and full of gentle carotenoids and fiber.
Tastes even richer reheated the next day.

recipes.title: Lebanese Hashweh-Style Cinnamon Ground Turkey & Rice
recipes.summary: Classic Levantine one-skillet supper combining lean ground turkey, warm rice, sweet onion, peas, and cozy ground cinnamon with cool yogurt on the side.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked jasmine or basmati rice

steps: Brown lean ground turkey and finely diced onion in olive oil 6 minutes, breaking into soft tender crumbles.
Stir in ground cinnamon, a pinch of salt and black pepper, frozen green peas, and 3 tbsp water and cook 3 minutes.
Fold in cooked rice until steaming and fragrant, serving warm with cool plain Greek yogurt on the side.
tips: Inspired by traditional Lebanese spiced rice (hashweh)—tender, easy to spoon, and deeply comforting.
Scatter toasted sliced almonds or pine nuts on top for classic crunch.

recipes.title: Maple, Orange & Cinnamon-Rubbed Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Moist baked salmon fillets brushed with sweet orange juice, pure maple syrup, olive oil, and warm ground cinnamon beside roasted sweet potatoes.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss cubed sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and half the cinnamon on a lined pan and roast 10 minutes first.
Whisk orange juice, maple syrup, remaining olive oil, and remaining cinnamon; place salmon on the pan, brush generously, and bake 12 minutes until flaky.
Plate warm salmon alongside caramelized cinnamon sweet potatoes.
tips: Warm cinnamon and bright orange complement rich omega-3 salmon beautifully.
One lined tray makes dinner effortless.

recipes.title: Silky Cinnamon-Spiced Lentil & Tomato Bolognese
recipes.summary: Rich plant-based weeknight Bolognese simmering brown lentils, finely diced carrots, onion, crushed tomatoes, olive oil, and a savory secret pinch of cinnamon.
steps: Saute diced onion and finely grated carrot in olive oil 5 minutes until sweet and soft, then stir in ground cinnamon 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, cooked lentils, and 1/3 cup water and simmer gently 12 minutes until thick and savory.
Toss with tender short pasta and serve warm.
tips: Grating the carrot instead of chopping makes it melt seamlessly into a rich, soft ragu.
A cozy pinch of cinnamon gives tomato sauce slow-simmered Sunday sweetness.

recipes.title: Warm-Spiced Cinnamon, Banana & Rolled Oats Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy bakery-style breakfast glass blending frozen banana, rolled oats, almond butter, oat milk, vanilla, and fragrant ground cinnamon.
steps: Place oat milk, rolled oats, frozen banana, almond butter, vanilla, and ground cinnamon in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until thick, frothy, and velvety.
Pour into a glass and dust lightly with an extra pinch of cinnamon.
tips: Tastes like a cozy cinnamon roll with pure whole-food fiber and zero added sugar.
Swap almond butter for sunflower seed butter for a nut-free breakfast.

recipes.title: Orchard Apple, Greek Yogurt & Ground Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Crisp apple-pie smoothie combining peeled sweet apple, plain Greek yogurt, milk, pitted date, and generous ground cinnamon.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, diced peeled apple, pitted date, ground cinnamon, and ice cubes in a blender.
Blend 55 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Peeling the apple first keeps the texture completely velvety and gentle to sip.
High-protein and naturally sweetened by fruit.

recipes.title: Velvety Pumpkin Puree, Banana & Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cozy harvest smoothie blending pure pumpkin puree, frozen banana, milk, plain yogurt, maple syrup, and warm ground cinnamon.
steps: Add milk, Greek yogurt, pumpkin puree, frozen banana, maple syrup, and ground cinnamon to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until lush orange and completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Real canned pumpkin delivers rich fiber and vitamin A in 4 minutes flat.
Swap dairy for oat milk for a plant-based autumn shake.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffin-Style Oats & Ground Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant purple smoothie uniting wild frozen blueberries, rolled oats, almond milk, Greek yogurt, vanilla, and fragrant ground cinnamon.
steps: Combine almond milk, Greek yogurt, rolled oats, frozen blueberries, vanilla, and ground cinnamon in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Tastes just like a warm cinnamon-streusel blueberry muffin in a nutritious frosty cup.
Rich in anthocyanins and soluble oat fiber.

recipes.title: Dark Cherry, Almond Milk & Ground Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety ruby smoothie blending frozen dark cherries, frozen banana, almond milk, flaxseed, and sweet warming ground cinnamon.
steps: Place almond milk, frozen dark cherries, frozen banana, ground flaxseed, and ground cinnamon in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, thick, and ruby purple.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Sweet dark cherries and fragrant cinnamon pair like warm cherry cobbler without added sugar.
Dairy-free and rich in gentle omega-3 fiber.

recipes.title: Crisp Pressed Apple Cider & Ground Cinnamon Cooler
recipes.summary: Orchard-sweet unfiltered apple cider briefly steeped with ground cinnamon and fresh lemon juice, strained crystal clear over ice.
steps: Warm pressed apple cider with ground cinnamon and ginger slices 3 minutes without boiling, then steep 2 minutes off heat.
Strain through a fine paper filter or fine sieve and stir in fresh lemon juice.
Pour over ice for a crisp orchard press—or enjoy warm in mugs.
tips: Filtering out the ground cinnamon leaves bright, clean spiced cider with zero gritty sediment.
Naturally sweet with zero sugar added.

recipes.title: Moroccan Fresh Sweet Orange & Ground Cinnamon Press
recipes.summary: Inspired by classic Moroccan orange-cinnamon salads: freshly squeezed orange juice shaken cold with a whisper of cinnamon and chilled water.
steps: Combine freshly squeezed orange juice, chilled water, and ground cinnamon in a lidded jar.
Shake briskly 15 seconds until lightly frothy and evenly spiced.
Pour over ice cubes and sip promptly.
tips: Sweet orange and fragrant cinnamon are a timeless North African pairing—crisp, hydrating, and full of vitamin C.
Use a cinnamon stick as an optional zero-sediment stirrer.

recipes.title: Mexican Agua de Jamaica (Hibiscus, Lime & Cinnamon Press)
recipes.summary: Jewel-crimson caffeine-free refresher steeping dried hibiscus petals with fragrant ground cinnamon, fresh lime juice, and a touch of honey.

ingredient_details.item: dried hibiscus flowers (or 2 hibiscus tea bags)

steps: Steep hibiscus and ground cinnamon in 2 cups hot water covered 6 minutes, then strain cleanly through a fine sieve or coffee filter.
Stir honey into the deep ruby brew until dissolved, cool briefly, and add fresh lime juice.
Serve over tall glasses of ice.
tips: Agua de Jamaica spiced with cinnamon is a beloved Mexican hydration staple with zero caffeine.
Tastes like brisk ruby cranberry-cinnamon lemonade.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry & Ground Cinnamon Sparkling Press
recipes.summary: Crisp antioxidant cooler shaking pure tart cherry juice with a warm pinch of cinnamon and topping with sparkling water over ice.
steps: Shake tart cherry juice, sweet orange juice, and ground cinnamon in a small jar 10 seconds until blended.
Pour over a tall glass of ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir lightly, and enjoy immediately.
tips: Sweet orange juice balances tart cherry effortlessly without needing syrup.
Peaceful, caffeine-free evening refresher.

recipes.title: Chilled Sweet Pear, Lemon & Ground Cinnamon Press
recipes.summary: Mellow pure pear juice shaken frosty with bright fresh lemon juice, cold water, and fragrant ground cinnamon.
steps: Combine pure pear juice, chilled water, fresh lemon juice, and ground cinnamon in a lidded jar.
Shake briskly 12 seconds until lightly frothy.
Pour over ice cubes and enjoy crisp.
tips: Delicate, gently sweet, and ready in 2 minutes.
Also lovely warmed gently on crisp mornings.
